all_found.desc: [BUG] The Stop-gate opt-in is written only by ApplyHookInstall after the conflict check, so in a repo with a foreign core.hooksPath (husky, lefthook, beads) or active .git/hooks an unforced install refuses and the opt-in is never recorded; setup --check's remediation points at that same refusing command. Repos with other hook managers (incl. this clone, core.hooksPath=.beads/hooks) were gated before #194 and are now silently ungated; the only ways back are --force (clobbers their hooks) or an undocumented manual git config.

[BUG] The hook exits 0 silently when the key is not 'true', without distinguishing a repo that never opted in from one whose metareview git gate is installed but whose opt-in is missing (upgraded pre-#194 install, or an agent running `git config --unset metareview.stopGate`). An agent can silently disable its own turn-end gate, and upgraded installs silently lose the Stop gate — contradicting the script's own 'stand down loudly' rule.

[ADVISORY] withStopGateOptIn keeps enforcement.active true for a repo that has not opted in; the amended AC says setup --check reports the Stop gate as inactive there. Consumers of enforcement.active see an active gate where it does nothing.

[ADVISORY] Nothing ties the Go StopGateKey to the key hard-coded in hooks/pre-finish.sh; a StopGateKey typo survives every test (mutation-verified). Key drift makes install report success while the hook stays inert everywhere, with CI green.
[ADVISORY] The Check() wiring of withStopGateOptIn is untested (removing it survives). The optedIn upgrade signal the docs rely on could vanish with no test failing.

[BUG] In a repo whose hook manager owns core.hooksPath (husky/lefthook/beads) with no opt-in, the SessionStart notice only says to run setup --install-hooks (which refuses with CONFLICT, whose message offers only --force); neither names --enable-stop-gate, and pre-finish.sh stays silent there. Such repos lose the Stop gate silently on upgrade and the in-session guidance points at a failing command or --force.

[BUG] The --enable-stop-gate hint fires for any non-empty core.hooksPath that is not the fully materialized target, including metareview's own paths that PlanHookInstall does not treat as conflicts (isOurHookPath): the legacy hooks/git install, and .metareview/git-hooks with deleted scripts. The notice then claims the path is set by another tool and install will refuse. On a legacy upgrade or vanished git-ignored scripts, the agent is steered to the Stop-gate-only opt-in and the push gate a plain --install-hooks would restore stays uninstalled (reproduced).
